transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Well... I suppose I'm just tired of trying to get people to understand. For months now, it's been... my husband's family. They're quietly messing with our money, and our good name. 

It's just little things, mostly. Like... billing errors showing up at my work. Or someone at church suddenly acting funny toward me. No matter what records anyone pulls up to try and prove me wrong, I just... I know it ties back to them.
Have you ever experienced any strange sensations or perceptions, like hearing voices or seeing things that others don't?
No... I don't hear voices. Nothing like that.
Have you ever felt like someone is putting thoughts into your mind or taking thoughts out of it?
No... I don't really know what you mean by that. My thoughts are just mine. Nobody is doing anything like that.
Do you have any other beliefs or suspicions that others might not share, that you feel strongly about even if there's no clear proof?
No... not really. Just what I already told you about his family. That's... that's the only thing going on. I don't know what else you're looking for.
Do you ever have any beliefs or ideas that others might find unusual or hard to believe, even if you can't prove them?
I thought I just answered that... No. I don't have any weird ideas. It's just what I already said. There's really nothing else to tell you.
Do you ever believe things that others might find hard to believe, even if you can't explain why you know them to be true?

I... I don't understand why you keep asking me the same question. I really don't. I've told you three times now. No. I don't have any strange beliefs. Just... just the situation I told you about. That's all.
Have you ever believed something very strongly, even when others have shown you clear evidence that it wasn't true?

Look, I... I don't know why we're still on this. I don't believe things that aren't true. I believe what's happening to me. 

I'm only here because... well, for months now I've been trying to get someone, anyone, to understand what my husband's family is doing. They're quietly messing with our money. And our good name. 

People say there's no proof, but... I see it. Like when little billing errors show up at work. I'm a billing clerk, I know when things aren't right. Or when someone at church suddenly acts funny toward me for no reason. People can pull up whatever records they want and tell me I'm wrong, but... I know it ties back to them. I just know it. That's not a strange belief. That's just what's happening.
Have you ever had any beliefs or suspicions, even about other things not related to your husband's family, that you felt very strongly about but others could not understand or accept?
No. Not really. Just... just what I already told you about. That's the only thing.
Even though people have looked into it and haven't found proof, do you still believe with absolute certainty that your husband's family is behind these problems with your money and reputation?

Yes. I do. I mean... I know what I see. 

I've already explained this. The errors at work, the way people look at me at church... it's them. I don't care if people can't find a piece of paper that proves it. I know they're doing it.
Even though people have looked into it and haven't found proof, do you still believe with absolute certainty that your husband's family is behind these problems with your money and reputation?

I... I thought I just answered that. Yes. 

Look, I wouldn't have spent months trying to get people to understand this if I wasn't sure. They are messing with our money. And our name. The little billing errors at my work, the people at church acting funny... it all ties back to them. It doesn't matter what records anyone pulls up. I just know it.
Even though there is no clear evidence that your husband's family is involved, do you still believe with complete certainty that they are responsible for these issues?

Yes. I... we just talked about this. 

I know they're doing it. The errors at work, the church people... it's them. I don't need evidence to know what I know.
Even though there is no clear evidence that your husband's family is involved, do you still believe with complete certainty that they are responsible for these issues?

Yes. I... we just went over this. 

I don't need to see proof. I know what they're doing. The money, the way people look at me... it's them. I'm certain.
Even though no one else can find any proof, and even though it seems like the facts don’t support your belief, do you still feel completely certain that your husband’s family is doing this to you?

Yes. I... I don't know why you keep asking me the same thing. 

I know they are. I've been trying to get people to see it for months. The billing errors, the church people... it's them. I don't care about what the facts say. I'm certain.
Is your belief that your husband’s family is doing this to you based on a feeling that they are trying to harm you or ruin your life in some way?
I... I don't know about all that. Harm me? I couldn't tell you what their reasons are, or what they want. I just know they're the ones behind it... that's all.
